## Mentoring

I am currently mentoring Elena Abbruzzi, an undergraduate student in applied math and electrical engineering, through the Univesity of Colorado's [Discovery Learning Apprenticeship](https://www.colorado.edu/engineering/students/research-opportunities/discovery-learning-apprenticeship-dla-program) (DLA) program. We are working to extend existing results about the structure of optimal controllers for one-dimensional PDEs to higher dimensions.
